top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, fully validated achievement: Holst's and Drucker's physiology of GLP-1 as an incretin and Mojsov's identification of the active form (GLP-1(7-36)) led directly to receptor-agonist therapies with transformative clinical impact in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation with the physiology-and-active-form citation is scientifically coherent and keeps the citation scope tight, and all six members support it, so no award is clearly inferior.
